metadata.question: Does nitrogen dioxide concentration in Wuhan city, China decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about nitrogen dioxide (NO2) concentration changes in Wuhan, China between two specific time periods in early 2020. This is a perfect use case for Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data, which provides NO2 measurements. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-5P NO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) 2. Define two time periods: Jan 1-20, 2020 and Feb 10-25, 2020 3. Create a geometry for Wuhan city area 4. Calculate mean NO2 concentration for each period 5. Compare the values to determine if there was a decrease Data quality considerations: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Validate the calculated values are reasonable (not NaN, within expected NO2 range) For NO2 data from Sentinel-5P, I'll use the 'NO2_column_number_density' band. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Wuhan geometry (approximate bounding box) var wuhan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[114.0, 30.8], [114.6, 30.8], [114.6, 30.4], [114.0, 30.4], [114.0, 30.8]] ]); // Define time periods var period1 = ['2020-01-01', '2020-01-20']; var period2 = ['2020-02-10', '2020-02-25']; // Get Sentinel-5P NO2 data var no2_col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(period1[0], period1[1]) .filterBounds(wuhan) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); var no2_col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(period2[0], period2[1]) .filterBounds(wuhan) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection sizes var size1 = no2_col1.size().getInfo(); var size2 = no2_col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 1-20 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Feb 10-25 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for each period var mean1_img = no2_col1.mean(); var mean2_img = no2_col2.mean(); // Get pixel counts and mean values var stats1 = mean1_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); var stats2 = mean2_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); var mean1 = stats1.NO2_column_number_density_mean; var count1 = stats1.NO2_column_number_density_count; var mean2 = stats2.NO2_column_number_density_mean; var count2 = stats2.NO2_column_number_density_count; console.log(`Jan Mean: ${mean1?.toFixed(6)} mol/m², Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Feb Mean: ${mean2?.toFixed(6)} mol/m², Pixels: ${count2}`); // Check for valid pixels if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Validate results if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2) || mean1 < 0 || mean2 < 0 || mean1 > 0.01 || mean2 > 0.01) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare and determine answer var decrease = mean2 < mean1; var changePercent = ((mean2 - mean1) / mean1 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${changePercent}%`); if (decrease) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
